{{Top}} {{Otheruses|Grizz}} {{Character |type=Rebel |image=[[File:GrizzFrix-DB.jpg]] |name=Grizz Frix |homeworld= |birth= |death=[[4 ABY]], [[Endor system]]{{Film|VI}} depicts Grizz Frix was killed at the [[Battle of Endor]], which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[4 ABY]]. |species=[[Human]]{{Film|VI}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]] |pronouns=new |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Black]] |feathers= |eyes=Brown |skin=Brown |cyber= |families=new |parents=new |partners=new |siblings=new |children=new |affiliation=*[[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] **[[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Red Squadron]]{{Databank|rebel-pilots|Rebel Pilots}} |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|She's gonna blow!|Grizz Frix's last words|}} '''Grizz Frix''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[human]] [[starfighter]] [[pilot]] who flew for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. He was recruited into the squadron after the [[Battle of Hoth]] and was killed during the [[Battle of Endor]], where he flew under the [[callsign]] [[Red Five]]. ==Biography== ===Joining Red Squadron=== {{Quote|Grizz Frix.''"
"''Another hothead. Still, he never brained a fellow rebel with a tray. And with that ringing endorsement, he's part of the squadron.|Wedge Antilles and Wes Janson, reforming Red Squadron|{{StoryCite|story=Rendezvous Point (short story)|book=From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back}}}} Shortly after the [[Battle of Hoth|evacuation of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY]],"[[Rendezvous Point (short story)|Rendezvous Point]]" is set in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Hoth]], which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[3 ABY]]. As such, the events in "Rendezvous Point" must have taken place around that year. [[Commander]] [[Wedge Antilles]] recruited Grizz Frix into the newly reformed [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Red Squadron]]. [[Lieutenant]] [[Wes Janson]] commented that Frix was another "hothead." On reporting on progress from sim training, Antilles told his superior [[the Contessa]] that Frix had no trouble flying in formation but kept breaking formation to chase down targets. ===Protecting the rendezvous point=== {{Quote|We lost Penn, Grizz, do not engage. Stay with me.|Bela Elar, to Grizz Frix|}} Days after Antilles reformed Red Squadron, the squadron was sent on a mission. Frix flew a [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]] as [[Bela Elar]]'s wingmate, alongside [[Penn Zowlie]], in an [[Attack on an asteroid mining station|attack]] on a nearby [[pirate]] base, that threatened the safety of the Alliance's rendezvous point. The squadron succeeded in eliminating the pirates. ===Battle of Endor=== [[File:GrizzFrixDeath-RotJ.png|thumb|left|220px|The death of Grizz Frix at the Battle of Endor.]] During the [[Battle of Endor]], Frix flew for Red Squadron under the [[callsign]] [[Red Five]].{{Databank|rebel-pilots|Rebel Pilots}} He [[Death|died]] when his T-65B X-wing starfighter exploded during an attack on an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer]]. ==Personality and traits== Grizz Frix was described as a hothead and was shown to be a skilled pilot as he had no trouble flying in formation. ==Behind the scenes== Grizz Frix was played by actor [[Ronny Cush]] in ''[[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|Return of the Jedi]]''.{{WebCite|url=http://www.jamaicaobserver.com/entertainment/ronny-cush-_137356|text=Ronny Cush – A true Jedi|author=Howard Campbell|date=2018-07-01|archivedate=20200130215937}}''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]'' Frix's helmet prop—or one of a matching design—was previously used by [[Jon Vander]] in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']], and [[Derek Klivian|"Hobbie"]] in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. It was also seen being carried by a different, unidentified pilot on [[Home One/Legends|''Home One'']] in ''Return of the Jedi''. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Grizz Frix}} *{{StoryCite|story=Rendezvous Point (short story)|book=From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back|audiobook=1}} *{{Film|VI}} {{1st}} *[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]] *{{StoryCite|story=When Fire Marked the Sky|book=From a Certain Point of View: Return of the Jedi|audiobook=1}} ==Sources== *{{SWE|groups|rebel-pilots|Rebel Pilots}} {{1stID|Grizz Frix}} *{{InsiderCite|165|An Ace in Space}} *''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' *{{BuildR2Cite|5|Droid Directory}} {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' *{{GoS|Dark Side (episode)}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Pilots of the Rebel Alliance}} *{{Databank|rebel-pilots|Rebel Pilots}} {{StartBox}} {{SuccessionBox |title=[[Red Five]] |years=[[3 ABY]] – [[4 ABY]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' |before=Eventually [[Luke Skywalker]]{{Film|IV}} |before-years=[[0 ABY]] |after= |after-years= }} {{EndBox}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Grizz Frix |ja=グリッズ・フリックス |ko=그리즈 프릭스 |nl=Grizz Frix |pl=Grizz Frix }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Frix, Grizz}} [[Category:Aces]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Red Squadron personnel]]
